fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Optional. Logo strips usually run without one, or with something like "As featured in".

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.description: Optional. A line or two under the heading, drawn as one paragraph.

nextjs.owes: a target of 300 characters in place of its maxLength of 300, shown with a count and never refused (the ruling of 19/11/2026)

wordpress.owes: the field, with a target of 300 characters, shown with a count and never refused

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.description: The most items across. Fewer fit on narrow screens.

wordpress.owes: the field; the strip lays itself out today

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Names the row, the link and, when the image has none, the alternative text.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Optional, such as the client's site or the press article.
